title: Type One Energy, UTK receive IRIS grant for fusion R&D
html:
The Tennessee Department of Economic and Community Development (TNECD) Office of Innovation has awarded its inaugural Innovation and Research for Industry Success (IRIS) grant to stellarator fusion technology developer Type One Energy, in partnership with the University of Tennessee–Knoxville. Type One Energy, which is headquartered in Knoxville, is working with UTK on a two-year project to develop a new class of coated ceramic breeder particles to be used in the production and management of tritium fuel for future fusion power plants.
